command.description: The command to run. Can be one of: main, inspect, inspect-version, inspect-tag, validate-config. Default: "main"

inspectVersion.description: [Deprecated] If set, Fork-Version will print the current version and exit.

files.description: List of the files to be updated.

glob.description: Glob pattern to match files to be updated.

path.description: The path Fork-Version will run from. Default: `process.cwd()`

changelog.description: Name of the changelog file. Default: "CHANGELOG.md"

header.description: The header text for the changelog.

type.description: The type of commit message. Example: "feat", "fix", etc..

scope.description: The scope of the commit message.

section.description: The section of the `CHANGELOG` the commit should show up in. Example: "Features", "Bug Fixes", etc..

hidden.description: Boolean indication if this type should show in the generated changelog message.

types.description: List of explicitly supported commit message types.

releaseMessageFormat.description: A string to be used to format the auto-generated release commit message.

releaseMessageSuffix.description: Add a suffix to the release commit message.

tagPrefix.description: Specify a prefix for the created tag. Default: "v"

preRelease.description: Make a pre-release with an optional label if the given value is a string. Example: true, "alpha", "beta"

currentVersion.description: Override default version determination by setting the current version.

nextVersion.description: Override default version determination by setting the next version.

releaseAs.description: Override version bumping to the targeted typed.

allowMultipleVersions.description: Don't throw an error if multiple versions are found in the given files. Default: `true`

commitAll.description: Commit all changes, not just files updated by Fork-Version.

changelogAll.description: If this flag is set, all default commit types will be added to the changelog, not just `feat` and `fix`.

dryRun.description: No output will be written to disk or committed.

silent.description: Run without logging to the terminal.

gitTagFallback.description: If unable to find a version in the given files, fallback and attempt to use the latest git tag. Default: `true`

sign.description: If true, git will sign the commit with the systems GPG key.

verify.description: If true, git will run user defined git hooks before committing.

asJson.description: Print inspected output as a parsable json string.

detectedGitHost.description: The detected git host, such as GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure Devops, the remote's origin URL for any other git host, or undefined if there's no git remote at all.

commitParserOptions.description: Options to pass to commits parser.

changelogWriterOptions.description: Override the commit types and URL formats used when generating the changelog.

commitUrlFormat.description: A URL representing a specific commit at a hash.

compareUrlFormat.description: A URL representing the comparison between two git SHAs.

issueUrlFormat.description: A URL representing the issue format.

userUrlFormat.description: A URL representing a user's profile on GitHub, Gitlab, etc.
